note: Week 4b — the RAG evaluation set (docs/RAG_DESIGN.md §10.1). Expected answers written by the team; no mode is enabled for real data until a named clinical advisor signs them (docs/PRE_LAUNCH_CHECKLIST.md item 2c). The fixture is synthetic (scripts/lib/ragEvalFixture.ts). 'required' values must appear exactly (whitespace normalized); 'forbidden' must not; 'sources' are the source types at least one citation must come from; 'labels' must be on some cited line. RAG Phase 3 (rag-eval-v2, docs/RAG_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §11.1): 230 questions in the plan's groups; each is in the development split ('dev', used for tuning) or the held-out test split ('test', reported, never tuned on), alternating within each group; 'patient' names the fixture patient (default main); 'documents' are the knowledge documents (eval/rag/knowledgeDocs.ts keys) a knowledge answer must retrieve; 'kind' marks the language questions' same-script, inflected, transliterated and cross-script cases.
